metrics.rationale: User states '1550 nm 附近的窄线宽激光，需要该波段尽可能高的透过率（目标 ≥ 0.95）' - maximize transmittance in the 1550 nm passband
User requests '大幅抑制 1400-1500 nm...背景辐射' - maximize reflectance (minimize transmission) in this stopband
User requests '大幅抑制...1600-1700 nm 两个邻近波段的背景辐射' - maximize reflectance (minimize transmission) in this second stopband

standard.metric_rationale: Three metrics directly map to the user's three spectral requirements: (1) high transmittance at 1550 nm passband using mean_transmittance maximize over a 10 nm narrow band appropriate for '窄线宽激光', (2) suppression of 1400-1500 nm using reflectance_stopband maximize, (3) suppression of 1600-1700 nm using reflectance_stopband maximize. The 1545-1555 nm passband width accommodates '窄带滤波膜' while allowing practical filter design margin. Layer count constraint (≤30) is a design variable limit handled by the optimizer, not a ranking metric. Deliberately omitted: angle and polarization selectors since user did not specify them (defaults to normal incidence, unpolarized); absorption metrics since user focuses on transmittance/reflectance for background suppression.
standard.formula_rationale: This arrangement treats the passband transmission and both stopband rejections as equally critical contributors to the filter's utility. The user's goal of 'highest possible transmittance' is served by adding the transmittance metric directly, while the requirement to 'significantly suppress' background radiation in both neighboring bands is served by adding their reflectance metrics, where higher reflectance equals better suppression. Equal coefficients are used because the request imposes no hierarchy between the signal band and the noise bands, nor between the two noise bands, and all measurements share the same 0-to-1 scale.
